candidate_reviews.reason: 37:116 ونصرناهم فكانوا هم الغالبين ('We helped them, so they prevailed') and 28:35 أنتما ومن اتبعكما الغالبون ('you two and those who follow you will prevail') explicitly parallel divine assurance and victory for Moses and Aaron.
37:117 وآتيناهما الكتاب المستبين and 28:43 ولقد آتينا موسى الكتاب both explicitly mention giving scripture to Moses (37:117 also Aaron).
37:117 and 6:154 both explicitly state God gave the Scripture to Moses; 37:117 additionally mentions Aaron.
Both verses name Isaac and contain the explicit annunciation of good tidings (بشر) in Abraham's household; differences of narrative perspective require explanation.

37:115 speaks of rescuing Moses, Aaron and their people from great distress; 7:137 describes formerly oppressed Israelites inheriting the land after Pharaoh's works are destroyed. Contextual, not direct lexical parallel.
